historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; uses the descriptive item phrase as a literal grep although decoded Type 3 output normally exposes a record-scoped Type field.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly distinguishes metadata from physical inspection but misclassifies the automatable metadata core.

original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 3 chassis Type enumeration for the intended enclosure matches the approved platform classification and remains correct after reboot; this metadata case does not itself inspect physical construction.
original_method: Capture complete Type 3 records, select the enclosure using serial/asset/BOM identity, extract its raw and decoded Type value, compare against the approved chassis classification and applicable enumeration, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the target enclosure, expected enum/classification and reboot plan. The Type 3 metadata extraction, enum validation and persistence comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved Type 3 chassis Type enum and decoded classification
Mapping from the descriptive source label to canonical Type
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not open, alter or physically inspect the chassis under this case.
Preserve full Type 3 records, raw enum and errors; do not rely on literal descriptive-label grep.
Do not confuse Type 3 chassis Type with Type 2 board Type or infer physical compliance solely from metadata.
Reject reserved/out-of-range enums and wrong-enclosure selection.
Stop on mapping ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 structures, bind the intended enclosure, decode and compare its raw Type enumeration before/after reboot.
Do not claim physical verification, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the enclosure mapping, canonical enum and platform classification.
Decide whether a separate physical inspection case is needed and issue the verdict for this metadata case.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not authoritative because the item phrase may not appear in decoded output; grep also drops enum/record provenance, suppresses errors and assumes insecure transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the descriptive source text, archive full Type 3 output/tool version/errors and parse the selected record's canonical `Type` field plus raw enumeration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The System Enclosure or Chassis Types wording, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select the exact enclosure record, compare its raw Type byte and decoded classification against the applicable SMBIOS and project baseline, and retain both representations across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 System Enclosure or Chassis Types enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses canonical field/enum parsing rather than a descriptive-label grep and explicitly limits scope to metadata.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; physical construction remains a separate manual coverage item if required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Decoded labels can vary by tool/spec revision; the raw enum is needed for reproducibility.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose the applicable rack, blade, enclosure or other allowed classification for its exact chassis/BOM, but must retain the raw enum and cannot treat this metadata read as physical inspection evidence.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected chassis Type enum/classification, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 records plus selected raw/decoded Type
Engineer verdict and link to any separate physical-inspection evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The descriptive plural wording maps unambiguously to the Type 3 chassis Type enumeration; no competing operation is specified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The metadata field is identifiable and safely readable; expected enum and mapping are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects the fragile descriptive-label filter while retaining the Type 3 metadata intent.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps physical-versus-metadata separation and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds raw-enum provenance, record selection and explicit exclusion of unperformed physical inspection.

review_improvement: Avoids false empty output and prevents a decoded chassis label from being accepted without the correct record, enum and platform mapping.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source asks for a Type 3 information field and persistence, not human observation. Once reference inputs are approved, the core is software-controlled.
